EXPERIENCES · 体験
What we stage

Celebrations on wheels,
filmed like cinema.

Every plan includes a dedicated chauffeur and private photo time. Champagne glasses, balloons and photo bouquets come standard. Bring your own drinks and food — the space is yours.

01

Limousine Party

Private LED-lit cabin cruises through Osaka & Kobe for birthdays, girls' nights and surprises. 60–90 min or half-day.

02

Bridal & Anniversaries

Proposals, wedding entrances and memorial days, staged with our partner florist FLORIST HIROKO.

03

Photo & Video Shoots

Collaboration shoots with restaurants and luxury boutiques. Our limousines are the backdrop Kansai talks about.

04

Night Cruise Kobe

Sannomiya → Maiko Park. 120 minutes under the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge lights. One car per night, weekdays.

05

KIX Inbound Cruise

Kansai Airport to Osaka's hotels and business districts — arrive like a headline act, with optional city shoots.

06

Takarazuka Theater Tour

From the Grand Theater along the Hana-no-Michi to dolce at Ashiya Marina. Around 2 hours, up to 8 guests.

07

Cruiser & Awaji Plans

Bayliner cruising from Imazu Marina, on-board parties for 16, and the Awaji Island sushi-and-shrine day plan.

08

Seasonal Illuminations

Midosuji illumination cruises from Umeda to Shinsaibashi each winter — limited weekday pricing.

PLANS & PRICING · 料金
Plans & pricing

Clear plans. Tax included.
No surprises at the kerb.

All prices include 10% consumption tax, a dedicated chauffeur and private photo time. Annual and monthly corporate contracts are available with separate invoicing.

Bring your ownDrinks, light food and champagne are free to bring aboard. Fast food is not permitted. Broken glassware is charged.
CancellationAfter confirmation, cancellations on the day or the day before incur 100% of the plan fee. Please choose your date with care.
Corporate contractsAnnual and monthly agreements with separate rate settings and consolidated invoicing. Ask us for a proposal.
